// Qualified module values flow into the typed application.
module app;import "project.facade" { token; }.values;start(){(values.token*3+7).return;}
summary: This application is derived from the RF172 typed multiunit scenario. A core module exports token=29, a facade re-exports it, and the consumer calculates 29*3+7=94. Three separate source units are required.
title: Three units with a re-exported value
